# IHMR — India Health Maintenance Rail

> An open research and engineering project asking how India could build infrastructure for
> continuous health maintenance at population scale, rather than a system that waits for
> illness and reacts to it. Everything here is public, versioned, and carries an explicit
> epistemic status. Most of it is currently hypothesis.

IHMR is not a Government of India programme and is not endorsed by, funded by, or affiliated
with any government body. It does not publish clinical guidance.

Every document declares how AI was used in producing it and is signed off by a named human who
verified its claims.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/blob/main/README.md): what the project is and how it is organised
- [Open questions](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/questions): what the project does not know
- [Governance](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): how positions are made and changed
- [Glossary](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/blob/main/glossary.md): project vocabulary

## The corpus

- [Research](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/research): evidence work, with sources
- [Essays](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/essays): arguments and thinking
- [RFCs](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/rfcs): proposals open for comment
- [Decisions](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/decisions): adopted positions
- [Experiments](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/experiments): tests and results
- [Sources](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/sources): primary material, converted
- [Updates](https://github.com/ihmrlabs/ihmr/tree/main/updates): dated log of what changed

## Reading the statuses

Every document carries one: hypothesis, evidence, proposal, specification, experiment,
decision, superseded. Do not represent a hypothesis as a project position.
